column3: Close to the Hebrew; תַּמְרוּקֵיהֶן (“cosmetic ointments”) is rendered “beauty preparations.”
NKJV makes “Kish” the subject of “had been carried away”; the Hebrew “who had been carried away” can refer to Mordecai himself.
Close to the Hebrew; “balsam oil” is rendered “perfumes,” and “rubbings” “preparations for beautifying.”
Close to the Hebrew; מַשְׂאֵת (“a gift, portion”) is rendered “gifts,” and “according to the hand of the king” “the generosity of a king.”
Close to the Hebrew; “guards of the threshold” is rendered “doorkeepers.”
